Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Cloak makes an attack, she has Advantage on the attack roll.

Actions.name: Shortsword
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing + 3 (1d6) poison; target poisoned until start of Cloak's next turn.

Actions.name: Light Crossbow
Actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 5) piercing; if target has not taken a turn since end of Cloak's last turn, add 7 (2d6) piercing.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.

Reactions.name: You Should've Been Watching Me
Reactions.text: When a creature within 5 ft. hits one of Cloak's allies with an attack, Cloak makes a Shortsword attack against the attacker; if it hits, the ally and attacker can be swapped.

LegendaryActions.name: Assassin's Strike
LegendaryActions.text: Moves up to her speed and makes Shortsword attack. On hit, deals 6d10 piercing instead of normal damage, and it does NOT inflict poisoned. On miss, deals half damage.

Description: Ambusher/protector. Start hidden if possible, use poisoned Shortswords to pressure one target, and use the reaction to punish anyone who attacks her allies. Iron Ring 2/day.
